result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd recommend **Xero, QuickBooks or FreeAgent**\. The best choice depends on how your business operates, how many employees you have and whether you're VAT registered.

Here's how I'd compare them in 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

From around £7/month + VAT

- Easy-to-use dashboard.
- Excellent bank reconciliation.
- Good VAT and financial reporting.
- Unlimited users on its plans.
- Lots of integrations.

Best for businesses that want to grow.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks**

(Best all-round alternative)

From around £10/month + VAT

- Straightforward invoicing.
- Tracks income and expenses.
- Good bank transaction matching.
- Useful mobile app.
- Strong accountant support.

Best for general small business bookkeeping.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Review: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AWrYG5UElICV_2QqNniGBOJg-DuJb7bzMDkMbcm700h1nQnWQTJ-0M80r1lnMU0oD2rFCgi2YvXIZB2Umi8wczyWPQfft3pogJ8F48-Lsaw-bXn26n8ROlYeIROX9k57q9T8hKC5ow8yJaZsxkoZIQjbRlS28cXXnAUhnN7Xx_NmwItPbM1G2HrfhOQcoZLf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent**

(Best for sole traders)

Free with certain eligible bank accounts

- Simple income and expense tracking.
- Self Assessment support.
- VAT returns.
- Invoicing and expense management.

Particularly good for freelancers and one-person businesses.

[Visit FreeAgent](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sage Accounting**

Pricing depends on plan

- Strong accounting and VAT features.
- Good financial reporting.
- Payroll options.
- Established accountant ecosystem.

Best for businesses with more traditional accounting requirements.

[Visit Sage](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

Free plan available, paid plans vary

- Good automation.
- Invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful reporting.
- Integrates with other Zoho products.

Best for keeping software costs down.

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/)

Pricing is indicative and promotional offers or plan limits can change. ## My recommendation

If I were choosing accounting software for a typical small UK business\:

- **Xero\:** My first choice for a growing business.
- **QuickBooks\:** My first choice for straightforward day-to-day bookkeeping.
- **FreeAgent\:** My first choice for a sole trader.

One important consideration is Making Tax Digital (MTD). Make sure the package supports the relevant HMRC requirements for your business.
